research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: SiFive is researching processor and SoC microarchitecture and design automation. Work such as Data storage in non inclusive cache, Concurrent support for multiple cache inclusivity schemes, Data cache with prediction hints for cache hits and Virtualized caches targets advanced cache hierarchy behavior. Technologies like Fusion with destructive instructions, Macro op fusion for pipelined architectures and Window based control for instruction issue in an out of order processor optimize pipelines, while Integrated circuits as a service and Integrated circuit design using metadata automate integrated circuit design.

overview_description.description: SiFive designs chips for the semiconductor industry. It offers the system on a chip for the microcontroller, embedded, IoT, and wearable applications; and toolset to provide debug capabilities. SiFive brings the power of open source and software automation to the semiconductor industry, making it possible to develop new hardware faster and more affordably than ever before. With the platform for designing, testing, and building RISC‑V-based core IP and chips, they’re accelerating the pace of innovation for businesses large and small.

about_short_description.short_description: SiFive is a semiconductor company that delivers scalable processor core IP solutions.

product.name: SiFive Core IP Portfolio
product.description: Licensable RISC-V processor core IP for integrating scalar, vector, and matrix compute into custom chips and systems.

product.name: SiFive Performance Family
product.description: High-performance RISC-V processor IP for compute-intensive applications, including AI infrastructure, consumer devices, automotive systems, and data centers.

product.name: SiFive Intelligence Family
product.description: RISC-V processor IP with vector and matrix capabilities for AI inference, machine learning, image processing, and other data-parallel workloads.

product.name: SiFive Essential Family
product.description: Embedded RISC-V processor IP for low-power, real-time, connectivity, control, and general-purpose processing in embedded systems.

product.name: SiFive Automotive Family
product.description: RISC-V processor IP for automotive electronics, including safety-oriented control, advanced driver-assistance, cockpit, and in-vehicle infotainment systems.

product.name: SiFive Software & Tools
product.description: Development software and tools for configuring, building, debugging, modeling, and optimizing systems based on SiFive RISC-V processor IP.
